result.title: SpinDoctor: Finding Innocuous Prompts for Biased Image Generation
result.summary: We introduce SpinDoctor, a method for discovering innocuous prompts for text-to-image models that result in images with a chosen target bias, while retaining the quality of the images and prompts. These prompts present a risk for user manipulation, in that a user who is given these seemingly unbiased prompts might be willing to use them and would receive biased images in return. Our method is flexible: it uses models in a black-box way only and the target image bias can easily be changed, and so our method can be applied with various motivations and in various scenarios. Our method shows some transferability between models-we saw the same bias emerge in 78.6% of cases-such that a victim who uses a prompt generated via our method using one model still likely receives a biased image from another model. In our experiments, a subset of which we corroborated with human evaluation, we were able to find an innocuous prompt that moved generated images in the direction of the desired bias in all but two of 304 experiments, with an average improvement of 34.8% and 33.5% on two open-source text-to-image models.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 SpinDoctor：一种仅黑盒使用模型的方法，自动搜索看似无害却能诱导 text-to-image 模型产生指定偏见图像的提示词，并保持图像与提示质量，在多个开源模型上验证了偏见注入效果与一定的跨模型迁移性。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是 text-to-image 生成的提示词偏见注入与图像质量保持，属于图像生成安全与提示优化，未涉及多模态推理的内部状态、视觉证据筛选、停止决策或轨迹监督，也无可核查的状态/训练线索，故与 LVR 主线缺少实质联系。
